entries.trigger: Elisha got a double portion of the anointing.
entries.answer: That's inheritance language. He asked to be the heir, not to be twice as strong.

entries.trigger: The disciples already had the Holy Spirit.
entries.answer: Yahushua said the Spirit was with them and would be in them. Two different things.
Yahushua said it hadn't been given yet. He said that after John was dead.

entries.trigger: Joel said in the last days Yahuah would pour out His Spirit.
entries.answer: Joel described a condition, not an event. A new temple, not a revival.

entries.trigger: Peter calls believers a royal priesthood. That's a New Testament thing.
entries.answer: It's a quote from Sinai. He offered it to every household before He narrowed it to one.

entries.trigger: Our job is to change the culture.
entries.answer: Salt slows corruption. It does not reverse it. You were given a mark to carry, not a world to fix.

entries.trigger: He's preparing a mansion for me.
entries.answer: He said dwelling, not mansion. And He said He would make it with you, here.

entries.trigger: Satan fell from heaven with a third of the angels.
entries.answer: The apostles reported the fruit; Yahushua told them what it meant in the unseen world.
